# RWROPS — Tactical Data Terminal
> Running with Rifles game data browser and community guide hub.

## Site Structure
- Home: /
- Game Data Index: /params
  - Weapons: /params/weapon
  - Vehicles: /params/vehicle
  - Carry Items: /params/carry_item
  - Projectiles: /params/projectile
  - Calls: /params/call
  - Achievements: /params/achievement
  - Factions: /params/faction
  - Ranks: /params/rank
  - Stances: /params/stance
  - Map Configs: /params/map_config
  - Commands: /params/command
- Documentation: /docs
  - Articles: /docs/{article-slug}

## Key Features
- Browse all RWR game entities with translated names (CN/EN/DE/ES/FR/RU)
- Interactive exchange/roll simulations for loot items
- Weapon performance visualization with 3D models
- Community-authored guides in Markdown (MDX)
- Full-text search across game data and documentation
- Tactical CRT terminal aesthetic

## Tech Stack
- React 19 + Vite 8
- Material UI v6
- react-router-dom v7 (History API)
- Three.js via @react-three/fiber for 3D previews

## Notes
- All game data is loaded from a static JSON manifest at /data/result.json
- Articles are .mdx/.md files in docs/articles/
- Multi-language support: cn, en, de, es, fr, ru
